title.narrative: Green, Resilient, and Inclusive Development Program (Subprogram 1)

description.narrative: GRID is a novel homegrown approach to development that holistically addresses the set of overlapping and reinforcing crises, including climate-induced hazards, to ensure development activities are more greener, more resilient, and more inclusive. The GRID approach enables Nepal to meet its commitments on climate adaptation, resilience, and disaster risk management, as set out in its nationally determined contribution and national adaptation plan. The government, ADB and 15 other development partners have jointly adopted the GRID approach. The proposed PBL will support the government in operationalizing the GRID approach by unlocking policy, regulatory, and institutional bottlenecks to promote sustainable investment opportunities across sectors.

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

1.1. The Cabinet endorsed and submitted to parliament in June 2024 the Water Resources Bill to promote integrated water resource management at the river basin level, preserve surface and ground water resources, control water pollution, and foster sustainable use of water and water related materials.

1.2. (i) The Cabinet approved River and Water Related Disaster Management National Policy in December 2023 to promote integrated water resource management including multipurpose projects in river basins, and to enhance disaster preparedness by facilitating the adoption of remote sensing system, geographical information system, open-source technology, and forecast based financing; and (ii) NDRRMA approved construction design standards, including financial incentives for its adoption, to promote the use of indigenous construction materials for recovery and reconstruction.

1.3. (i) The Cabinet approved the Wildlife-friendly Infrastructure Development Directives in April 2022 to enhance balance between conservation needs and infrastructure development; and (ii) transport sector started piloting the directives in May 2023.

1.4. (i) MOEWRI approved Renewable Energy Subsidy Operational Procedures effective December 2022 to promote energy security through the adoption of small and micro hydropower, biogas, biomass, solar, and wind; and (ii) the Cabinet endorsed and submitted in June 2024 to the parliament a REEE bill to strengthen the mandate of AEPC to promote renewable energy and enhance energy efficiency.

1.5. The Parliament approved Finance Act 2024, which imposed green tax on imported petroleum products and coal effective July 2024 in line with its NDC commitments to reduce carbon emissions and promote low carbon transition.
1.6. The Cabinet approved Green Hydrogen Policy 2024 on 18 January 2024 to promote hydrogen energy as a clean and alternative energy source to petroleum fuel and natural gas.

description.narrative:
Action 1: 1.1 The Cabinet endorsed and submitted to parliament in June 2024 the Water Resources Bill to promote integrated water resource management at the river basin level, preserve surface and ground water resources, control water pollution, and foster sustainable use of water and water related materials. Base year: 2022 Target date: 2024-10-31 Target value: 1
Action 2: 1.2 (i) The Cabinet approved River and Water Related Disaster Management National Policy in December 2023 to promote integrated water resource management including multipurpose projects in river basins, and to enhance disaster preparedness by facilitating the adoption of remote sensing system, geographical information system, open-source technology, and forecast based financing; and (ii) NDRRMA approved construction design standards, including financial incentives for its adoption, to promote the use of indigenous construction materials for recovery and reconstruction. Base year: 2022 Target date: 2024-10-31 Target value: 1
Action 3: 1.3 (i) The Cabinet approved the Wildlife-friendly Infrastructure Development Directives in April 2022 to enhance balance between conservation needs and infrastructure development; and (ii) transport sector started piloting the directives in May 2023. Base year: 2022 Target date: 2024-10-31 Target value: 1
Action 4: 1.4 (i) MOEWRI approved Renewable Energy Subsidy Operational Procedures effective December 2022 to promote energy security through the adoption of small and micro hydropower, biogas, biomass, solar, and wind; and (ii) the Cabinet endorsed and submitted in June 2024 to the parliament a REEE bill to strengthen the mandate of AEPC to promote renewable energy and enhance energy efficiency. Base year: 2022 Target date: 2024-10-31 Target value: 1
Action 5: 1.5 The Parliament approved Finance Act 2024, which imposed green tax on imported petroleum products and coal effective July 2024 in line with its NDC commitments to reduce carbon emissions and promote low carbon transition. Base year: 2022 Target date: 2024-10-31 Target value: 1
Action 6: 1.6 The Cabinet approved Green Hydrogen Policy 2024 on 18 January 2024 to promote hydrogen energy as a clean and alternative energy source to petroleum fuel and natural gas. Base year: 2022 Target date: 2024-10-31 Target value: 1
Action 1: 2.1 The government will (i) approve regulations to implement the Water Resources Bill; (ii) pilot SESA for River Basin Development Plan covering the masterplans for irrigation and hydropower; and (iii) approve SESA guidelines for water resources and energy sectors. Base year: 2022 Target date: 2026-10-31 Target value: 1
